items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: If you worked with Noble Sissle, there was Jack Carter on the drums... He wasn't no Chick Webb, but he had rhythm and he had personality.

ctx.x: Yeah. See, but you had to be competent and you had not to be an obnoxious character. They'd put up with you, but after a while you'd head down with that. You'd find out... If you worked with Noble Sissle, there was Jack Carter on the drums, big diamonds on his finger. He wasn't no Chick Webb, but he had rhythm and he had personality. He was brash.
He wound up with a bar on Seventh Avenue didn't he?
